title: SasReveal
description: Request body of POST /api/v1/sessions/{sid}/sas (LSP-1 sections 4.3.4 and 5.1; LSP/1.1 secure profile, Increment 3): the sender reveals its SAS nonce `Ns` after it received the receiver's nonce `Nr` in `SessionStatus.sas`. The receiver recomputes the commitment `SHA-256("LSP1-SAS-C\0" || Ns || fpS || fpR)` and compares it with the `sasCommit` of the session request: a mismatch is 401 AUTH_INVALID and the session fails with PROTOCOL_ERROR. The 200 response is a SessionStatus (PENDING, still carrying `sas`). The request needs a valid `X-LS-Auth` proof. `nonce` is 16 random bytes, base64url without padding, exactly 22 characters. The object has the same shape as `SessionStatus.sas`. Unknown members MUST be ignored.

nonce.description: The sender's SAS nonce Ns: 16 random bytes, base64url, 22 characters.
